blocks.h2: Signs Your Elmhurst Water Heater Needs Help
blocks.intro: Most repair calls look like this:

tiles.body: Scale and sediment on the bottom of the tank.
Sediment taking up space, or a failing burner or element.
A valve leak is fixable. A tank leak isn't.
A pilot, igniter or thermostat that failed.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Problems in Elmhurst Homes
blocks.intro: Elmhurst's water is Lake Michigan water from the DuPage Water Commission, and the city reports its hardness at about 8 grains per gallon.

items.body: At that hardness, minerals settle in the tank every year. A yearly flush keeps it in check.
Many gas heaters still vent into the original chimney. We check the draft every time.
Low ceilings and narrow stairs matter when a heater has to come out.
Hardness affects tankless heat exchangers too.

bodies: We repair gas and electric tank heaters, power-vent units and tankless heaters in Elmhurst homes. We test first, then recommend.
When you call, read us the label: fuel, size and date. If it's time for a new one, see [water heater installation](/elmhurst/water-heater-installation).
With Elmhurst's hard water, a yearly flush makes a real difference. We drain the sediment, test the relief valve, check the anode rod and inspect the burner or elements and venting.
Tankless units get descaled on a schedule. If your heater has never been flushed, start here.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Why does my water heater pop and rumble?
items.answer: Sediment on the bottom of the tank traps water that boils as the burner fires. With Elmhurst's hardness, it builds up over time. Flushing helps.

items.q: Do I need emergency water heater service?
items.preview: If it's leaking from the tank, yes.
items.answer: If water is coming from the tank itself, shut off the water to it and call us right away. No hot water can usually wait for a scheduled visit.

items.q: Should I add a water softener?
items.preview: It can help heaters last longer.
items.answer: It can. Softer water means less scale in the heater and on fixtures. See [water filtration and softeners](/elmhurst/water-filtration-systems).

items.q: How long do water heaters last in Elmhurst?
items.answer: Usually somewhere around 8 to 12 years. Yearly flushing helps them reach the longer end.

items.q: Why is my hot water rusty?
items.preview: Usually the tank or anode rod.
items.answer: Usually a corroding tank or a worn anode rod. If only the hot side is rusty, the heater is the likely cause.

items.preview: It depends on the part. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of heater. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
